name: cozy-farm-3d-mobile
description: Capacitor wrappers for Cozy Farm 3D on Android and iOS

scripts.capgo:upload: npm run mobile:prepare && npx @capgo/cli@latest bundle upload --channel=production
scripts.android:add: npm run mobile:prepare && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.ios:add: npm run mobile:prepare && cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && cap sync ios
